question: Mirabai Chanu was selected as BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2022. She is related to which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weightlifting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu** is an Indian weightlifter who has been awarded the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2022.
 
• She has brought laurels to India by winning multiple medals in international weightlifting competitions.
 
• Mirabai Chanu won a silver medal in the Women's 49 kg category at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• She has also been a recipient of prestigious national awards like the Padma Shri and Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
 
• Her achievements have made her a prominent figure in the sport of weightlifting in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Weightlifting** is a sport where athletes attempt to lift maximum-weight single lifts of a barbell loaded with weight plates.
 
• The two competition lifts in order are the snatch and the clean and jerk.
 
• Weightlifting is a major part of the Olympic Games, with various weight categories for both men and women.
 
• India has a rich history in weightlifting, with several athletes achieving international success over the years.
